question: Should `OutboundMediaLoadOptions.optimizeImages` and `transcodeAudioBufferToOpus.maxDurationSeconds` become supported durable Plugin SDK contracts for bundled and external plugin callers?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused, but these exported shared-helper options define a public cross-plugin contract that cannot be safely accepted or rejected by an automated repair lane.

options.title: Approve the narrow SDK contracts
options.body: Accept the two generic option additions and merge after confirming the WhatsApp-focused delivery coverage remains representative.

options.title: Keep the behavior private to WhatsApp
options.body: Reject the shared option expansion and retain or redesign a WhatsApp-owned implementation if these controls are not intended for other plugins.

options.title: Pause for SDK contract guidance
options.body: Defer the PR until plugin SDK owners define the intended media-helper surface and compatibility promise.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow SDK contracts
recommendation.body: Accept the two generic option additions and merge after confirming the WhatsApp-focused delivery coverage remains representative.

likelyOwner.reason: The member contributor owns the current PR series and can clarify the intended boundary, while a broader SDK decision still needs repository maintainer approval.
